jobs.title: SAP IS-U ORT Lead
jobs.description:
**Role Description**

We are seeking a senior Operational Readiness Testing (ORT) Lead to support a major utility's SAP IS\-U billing and payments go\-live. This is a strategy\-level, PMO\-facing role. You will define and own the ORT approach — not simply execute a pre\-built test plan — and ensure business processes, systems and operational teams are fully ready for go\-live through testing, defect resolution and performance validation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the end\-to\-end ORT strategy, applying risk\-based testing principles to prioritize scope, scenarios and coverage
* Set clear ORT scope, objectives and exit criteria, and explain how ORT differs from SIT, UAT and regression testing to stakeholders and business sponsors
* Identify and manage ORT\-specific risks such as data readiness, environment stability, cutover dependencies and business sign\-off, and build mitigations into the strategy
* Coordinate and execute bill compare activities, validating calculated bills against expected results across rates, billing determinants and customer scenarios
* Manage mass runs for billing, invoicing and payment processing to confirm system stability, performance and production readiness
* Develop ORT scripts, scenarios and acceptance criteria aligned with business and regulatory requirements
* Partner with functional, technical and business teams to identify defects, track resolution and validate fixes through retesting
* Ensure readiness of downstream processes including bill print, payment posting, collections and customer communications
* Provide daily ORT status reporting, risk identification and mitigation recommendations to project leadership
* Work with business SMEs to validate operational procedures, job aids and training materials for cutover and post\-go\-live support
* Support mock cutover activities and validate end\-to\-end operational workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of IT/SAP experience, including 5\+ years in SAP IS\-U (preferred)
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP IS\-U Billing, Invoicing and Payments (FI\-CA)
* Demonstrated leadership of ORT, UAT or large\-scale testing cycles for utility implementations
* Proven ability to independently plan and lead a risk\-based ORT strategy for complex, multi\-workstream programs
* Deep understanding of billing determinants, rate structures and payment processing
* Experience executing or overseeing mass billing runs and bill comparison tools
* Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills

**Nice to Have**

* Experience taking at least one utility SAP IS\-U program through go\-live and hypercare
* Exposure to S/4HANA Utilities

Pay: From $100\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Juno Beach, FL 33408

jobs.description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**


Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the Sales and Distribution (SD) module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Quote\-to\-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**

• Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) module configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested \& deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices. • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects \& leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance \& product management workstreams. • Analyse business requirements related to sales quotations, sales orders management, order fulfilment, invoicing, returns and credit management processes. Internal • Configure core SD components such as sales order types, item categories, ATP, pricing procedures, delivery types, billing types and work with technical teams for WRICEF developments • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects. • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go\-live and hyper care activities. • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. • Collaborate with BRIM, MM, FI, PP and EWM module consultants to support cross\-functional processes.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Essential**: • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 7 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries. • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs \& support experience in Sales \& Distribution module in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects. • Extensive experience in the core SD customizing including Quotations, Sales contracts, Sales order management, Available to Promise (ATP), outbound logistics, pricing, billing and returns and credit management. • Hands\-on experience in SD configurations. • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in SD module and their integrations \& technology. • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications. • Strong communication skills in English, self\-driven and motivated. • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


**Desirable**: • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP SD. • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**


• Office based/Remote with occasional international travel. • Health and Safety accountability statements. • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis. Internal

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience across **SAP SOM, Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and FI\-CA**, along with strong ABAP development and SAP S/4HANA integration capabilities.

* 7\+ years of SAP technical development experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on SAP BRIM development experience.
* Strong experience in SAP BRIM components:
* Subscription Order Management (SOM)
* Convergent Charging (CC)
* Convergent Invoicing (CI)
* Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA)
* Strong ABAP development expertise.
* Hands\-on experience with BADIs, User Exits, Enhancements, RFCs, APIs, and OData services.
* Good understanding of subscription\-based and usage\-based billing models.
* Experience with SAP HANA and SAP S/4HANA integrations.
* Knowledge of middleware, API integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience in performance tuning, debugging, and production support.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP BRIM.
* SAP HANA Certification.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

Equivalent relevant professional experience may also be considered.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in mid\-to\-senior\-level professionals with **9\+ years of relevant experience**, strong hands\-on SAP BRIM development capabilities, and the ability to deliver scalable enterprise billing and revenue management solutions.

**If you have strong expertise in SAP BRIM (SOM, CC, CI, FI\-CA) and ABAP development, we would love to hear from you!**

jobs.description:
Our Deloitte team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.
   

  

 Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026
   

  

**Work You'll Do**
 As a Manager, Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Working on integrated project teams on a range of projects covering the entire lifecycle from strategy formulation through to design, development and the deployment of solutions.
* Bringing considerable billing management expertise to help design, develop and implement subscription billing solutions to transform client's billing processes.
* Interacting daily with key business and IT executives
* Leading multiple teams in various strategy and implementation activities.
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues
* Determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches
* Evaluating and validate analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Implementing and overseeing the quality of deliverables and effectively manage the team and day\-to\-day relationships to ensure exceptional performance.


 The successful Manager you will possess:
   

  

* Strong communication skills \- ability to communicate complex system concepts to a business audience in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to facilitate clients' most complex business requirements
* Knowledge of basic accounting policies, and implications
* Experience identifying creative solutions within configurable cloud systems or within boundary applications where customization is required
* Leadership \- proven ability to lead complex engagements, both business and technical, including multiple dependencies and integration points
* Problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment


**The Team**
 Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 8\+ years experience in subscription billing within consulting or industry, specifically focused on delivering cloud\-based subscription billing solutions
* 5\+ years experience with end\-to\-end implementations of Subscription Billing solutions (e.g. Zuora Billing, Oracle NetSuite, SAP BRIM)
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* A Bachelor's degree


 Preferred:
   

  

* Minimum 4 years of experience designing or optimizing lead\-to\-cash and record\-to\-report processes and end\-to\-end architectures.
* 4\+ years of direct experience across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including Design, Build, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Support.
* 4\+ years of practical experience applying Agile and Scrum methodologies to deliver technology or business solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience conducting architecture assessments and developing implementation roadmaps for subscription billing solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience designing and configuring cloud or SaaS\-based billing solutions in complex, multi\-entity environments.
* 3\+ years of experience designing integrations with upstream systems (such as Ordering, Provisioning) and downstream ERP applications (such as General Ledger)
* Minimum 1 year of experience managing teams of 5 or more people, including responsibility for performance, deliverables, and team development.


 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $ 134,500 \- $265,100\.
   

  

 You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: SAP S/4 HANA SD Application Expert
jobs.description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**


Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the Sales and Distribution (SD) module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Quote\-to\-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**


• Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) module configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested \& deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices. • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects \& leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance \& product management workstreams. • Analyse business requirements related to sales quotations, sales orders management, order fulfilment, invoicing, returns and credit management processes. Internal • Configure core SD components such as sales order types, item categories, ATP, pricing procedures, delivery types, billing types and work with technical teams for WRICEF developments • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects. • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go\-live and hyper care activities. • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. • Collaborate with BRIM, MM, FI, PP and EWM module consultants to support cross\-functional processes.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**


**Essential**: • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 7 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries. • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs \& support experience in Sales \& Distribution module in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects. • Extensive experience in the core SD customizing including Quotations, Sales contracts, Sales order management, Available to Promise (ATP), outbound logistics, pricing, billing and returns and credit management. • Hands\-on experience in SD configurations. • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in SD module and their integrations \& technology. • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications. • Strong communication skills in English, self\-driven and motivated. • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


**Desirable**: • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP SD. • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS** • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel. • Health and Safety accountability statements. • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

  



**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.
